source.mo_ta: Compiled by the Hieuban editorial team from the knowledge base and public-domain sources (editorial draft, awaiting expert review); meanings of compound numbers follow Cheiro, Book of Numbers (1926), retold in our own words and written neutrally.

muc.tieu_de: What does compound number 10 mean in Chaldean numerology?
muc.doan: Compound number 10 is the number of the turning cycle: sometimes things go well, sometimes they stall, and there is always a chance to start again. Cheiro called it the Wheel of Fortune and linked it to honour, faith and self-confidence. He also noted that the name of someone with this number tends to become widely known, so their everyday conduct is easily talked about too.

muc.tieu_de: How do you read a name that adds up to 10, such as “Nam”?
muc.doan: Following the meaning Cheiro gives 10, a name that totals 10 carries a reminder about reputation: the name becomes known easily, and whether the reputation is good depends on how you behave. “Nam” has only three letters: N carries 5, A carries 1, M carries 4, adding up to exactly 10. The Chaldean school gives weight to the name used every day, so this name is read as 10 even if the full name gives a different number. Reducing to 1 adds emphasis to the Sun's theme of stepping forward.

muc.tieu_de: Number 10 at work and in relationships
muc.doan: At work, a 10 usually suits roles that mean stepping forward to open something up or taking responsibility for an area under their own name. People with this number often dare to take a project back on after a first attempt failed. In relationships, they easily win people over with confidence, but can also forget to ask the other person's view. When things are going well, they tend to promise more than usual.

muc.tieu_de: How to use the energy of 10 well
danh_sach: Write down three things you achieved in your best recent month, so you have something to look at when things stall.
Put a little money or a backup plan aside while things are rising, rather than waiting for the downturn.
Before taking on another role with your name at the top, ask someone close how much they think you are already carrying.

bang.tieu_de: Names and birth dates that give compound number 10
bang.chu_thich: Each row is added using the Chaldean letter table (letters written without diacritics) or by adding the digits of the birth date; the compound number is the first number in the 10–52 range on the way to reduction, here 10.

hoi_dap.hoi: Is compound number 10 a lucky number?
hoi_dap.dap: Cheiro doesn't read 10 in terms of luck or bad luck. He uses the image of a wheel to say that both up and down are part of the turning, and that this number's strength is starting again quickly.

hoi_dap.hoi: Is a name total of 10 the same as a birth date total of 10?
hoi_dap.dap: Same symbolic meaning. The Chaldean school reads the everyday name as how others perceive you, while the birth date is the part you can't change; having both gives the theme of starting over more weight.

trich_dan.nghia: Cheiro describes 10 with the image of the Wheel of Fortune: linked to honour, faith and self-confidence; the name of someone with this number tends to become known, for good or ill depending on how they behave.

y_chinh: Compound number 10: Wheel of Fortune, reduces to 1 (the Sun)
Theme: ups and downs in turn, and the power to start again
The name “Nam” adds up to exactly 10 in the Chaldean table
What to do: build a backup while things are going well

muc.tieu_de: What does compound number 11 mean in the Chaldean school?
muc.doan: According to Cheiro, compound number 11 is strength being held back, like a clenched hand or a muzzled lion. He reads it as a reminder to watch for hidden obstacles and for trust placed in the wrong hands. In the Chaldean school, 11 is not a master number as in Pythagorean numerology; it is simply a compound number that reduces to 2.

muc.tieu_de: How should a name that totals 11 be understood?
muc.doan: Following the meaning Cheiro gives 11, a name totalling 11 carries a reminder about hidden obstacles and tests of trust: be careful rather than afraid. The first name “Duy” is a short example: D carries 4, U carries 6, Y carries 1, adding up to 11. This is the theme of the number, not a description of anyone called Duy. Reducing to 2, the Moon adds a shade of emotion and listening to this number.

muc.tieu_de: Compound number 11 in teamwork and in love
muc.doan: In a team, a person with 11 is often the one who spots the weak point of a plan early but hesitates to say so. In business, they usually need things in writing more than spoken promises. In love, they tend to wait for the other person to guess what they want. The habit of saying clearly what you want from the start helps them feel less let down.

muc.tieu_de: How can an 11 feel less “held back”?
danh_sach: Each week, say one small wish plainly instead of waiting for others to notice.
For significant money or effort, put it in a message or short note that both sides can reread.
When you feel doubtful about someone, ask one specific question to check before deciding whether to trust them.

bang.tieu_de: Names and birth dates that give compound number 11
bang.chu_thich: Each row is added using the Chaldean letter table (letters written without diacritics) or by adding the digits of the birth date; the compound number is the first number in the 10–52 range on the way to reduction, here 11.

hoi_dap.hoi: Is 11 a master number in Chaldean numerology?
hoi_dap.dap: No. The Chaldean school doesn't keep the master numbers 11, 22 and 33; 11 is read as a compound number with its own image, then reduced to the root number 2.

hoi_dap.hoi: Why does Cheiro use the image of a clenched hand for 11?
hoi_dap.dap: The image speaks of strength that is there but not yet released. He reads it as a reminder to be careful with what isn't yet clear, not as a prediction of any particular event.

trich_dan.nghia: Cheiro describes 11 with the image of a clenched hand and a lion held in check; he treats it as a warning about hidden obstacles and tests of trust, calling for care rather than fear.

y_chinh: Compound number 11: the clenched hand, reduces to 2 (the Moon)
Chaldean numerology doesn't treat 11 as a master number
The name “Duy” adds up to 11: D4 + U6 + Y1
What to do: say what you want, write agreements down

muc.tieu_de: What is compound number 12 in Chaldean numerology?
muc.doan: Cheiro links compound number 12 to the image of the sacrifice: setting aside your own plans to look after someone else's. He saw the number through the anxiety and endurance that come with it. A neutral reading today is learning to draw boundaries: helping because you choose to, not because you can't say no.

muc.tieu_de: What does a name that totals 12, such as “Huy”, say?
muc.doan: Following the meaning Cheiro gives 12, a name totalling 12 carries a reminder about sacrificing for others and the worry that comes with it — that is, remembering to keep something for yourself while helping. The first name “Huy” adds H5, U6 and Y1 to make 12. That reminder belongs to the number 12; everyone called Huy still lives in their own way. Reducing to 3 (Jupiter), the number also carries the theme of learning and passing on what you know.

muc.tieu_de: A person with 12 at work and in the family
muc.doan: At the office, a 12 is often the one who stays late to finish work others left undone. The boss appreciates it, but that effort often goes uncredited. In the family, they are often the one who organises memorial days, does the school run and keeps the calendar. When work is clearly shared out, their dedication is seen and they feel less short-changed.

muc.tieu_de: Suggestions for a 12 to give without running dry
danh_sach: Before taking on more, ask yourself: could someone else do this?
Keep one evening a week when you don't agree to any requests.
When you have done something for someone, tell them briefly what you did, so the effort is acknowledged.

bang.tieu_de: Names and birth dates that give compound number 12
bang.chu_thich: Each row is added using the Chaldean letter table (letters written without diacritics) or by adding the digits of the birth date; the compound number is the first number in the 10–52 range on the way to reduction, here 12.

hoi_dap.hoi: Does compound number 12 mean always getting the short end of the stick?
hoi_dap.dap: Not necessarily. Cheiro's image of the sacrifice speaks of a tendency to set yourself aside for others; once you notice it, you can choose when to help and when to say no.

hoi_dap.hoi: How do you read a birth date whose digits total 12?
hoi_dap.dap: For example, 26/01/2001 adds 2+6+0+1+2+0+0+1 to give 12. The Chaldean school reads this as a life path with the shade of the sacrifice, reducing to 3.

trich_dan.nghia: Cheiro links 12 to the image of the self-sacrificing person, or the victim of someone else's plans, along with anxiety; a neutral reading reminds people with this number to keep something for themselves while helping others.

y_chinh: Compound number 12: the sacrifice, reduces to 3 (Jupiter)
Strengths: devoted, reliable, often carries shared work
Watch for: taking on more than your share, then quietly wearing out
What to do: keep one evening free of requests

muc.tieu_de: Is 13 a bad number in Chaldean numerology?
muc.doan: No. Cheiro wrote that 13 is not as frightening as many people think; he read it as the number of change: changing plans, changing places, changing how you live. The image he used is a skeleton with a scythe, but the main idea is that the old has served its purpose so the new has room. The Chaldean school reduces 13 to 4.

muc.tieu_de: How should the name “Giang”, which totals 13, be understood?
muc.doan: Following the meaning Cheiro gives 13, a name totalling 13 carries a reminder about transformation: changing plans, changing places, and putting that power of renewal to the right use. “Giang” adds G3, I1, A1, N5 and G3 to make 13. Cheiro states plainly that 13 is not a number to fear, so this is a theme to reflect on, not a verdict. Linked to the root number 4 (Uranus), the theme of leaving the beaten track becomes clearer still.

muc.tieu_de: Number 13 at work and in love
muc.doan: At work, a 13 usually suits restructuring projects, process overhauls, clearing out old data. People with this number are often the ones who propose dropping something the whole team keeps out of habit. In love, they need someone who can handle change. The thing to watch is changing because they are bored, rather than because change is needed.

muc.tieu_de: How to use the rhythm of change of 13
danh_sach: Before getting rid of something, write down what it still helps with; if it still helps, keep part of it.
Change step by step: one change a month, not everything in one week.
Pick one object or habit you haven't used for more than a year and give it away this week.

bang.tieu_de: Names and birth dates that give compound number 13
bang.chu_thich: Each row is added using the Chaldean letter table (letters written without diacritics) or by adding the digits of the birth date; the compound number is the first number in the 10–52 range on the way to reduction, here 13.

hoi_dap.hoi: Why is 13 so often seen as unlucky?
hoi_dap.dap: That is a common Western belief. Cheiro himself wrote that 13 is not as frightening as people think, but rather the number of change.

hoi_dap.hoi: If I was born on the 13th, do I carry compound number 13?
hoi_dap.dap: Yes. In the Chaldean school, a birth day of 13 is read as compound number 13 and then reduced to 4, carrying the theme of change and renewal.

trich_dan.nghia: Cheiro describes 13 with the image of a skeleton holding a scythe, but makes clear it is not a number to fear; he reads it as the number of transformation, changing plans and changing places, a power to be used for the right purpose.

y_chinh: Compound number 13: change and renewal, reduces to 4
Cheiro: 13 is not as frightening as popular belief holds
The name “Giang” adds up to 13 in the Chaldean table
What to do: change step by step, keep what still works

muc.tieu_de: What does compound number 14 say according to Cheiro?
muc.doan: Compound number 14 is the number of movement and combination: people with people, tasks with tasks, goods with money. Cheiro saw it as favourable for trade, exchange and travel. It comes with a reminder not to rely entirely on other people's advice, especially where money is involved.

muc.tieu_de: How is a name that totals 14, such as “Linh”, read?
muc.doan: Following the meaning Cheiro gives 14, a name totalling 14 carries a reminder about movement, transactions and connecting people with work, together with advice to think before following others' advice. “Linh” adds L3, I1, N5 and H5 to make 14. The meaning is about the number, so two people both called Linh can still be very different. Reducing to 5 (Mercury), 14 stresses flexibility and exchange.

muc.tieu_de: Number 14 in business and relationships
muc.doan: In business, a 14 usually suits sales, brokering, trade and transport — places where everything keeps moving. They tend to close deals fast, sometimes faster than they should. In relationships, they are fun and full of stories, but can make plans and then forget them. A list of what they have promised helps them keep their word.

muc.tieu_de: Using 14 with a steady hand
danh_sach: For any investment, read the terms yourself at least once rather than relying on what the person who introduced it tells you.
Set a fixed day each week to review the commitments you have made.
When an opportunity arrives too quickly, sleep on it before you answer.

bang.tieu_de: Names and birth dates that give compound number 14
bang.chu_thich: Each row is added using the Chaldean letter table (letters written without diacritics) or by adding the digits of the birth date; the compound number is the first number in the 10–52 range on the way to reduction, here 14.

hoi_dap.hoi: Does compound number 14 suit business?
hoi_dap.dap: Cheiro describes 14 as favourable for transactions, money and travel. He also reminds people with this number to check things for themselves before following others' advice.

hoi_dap.hoi: What does the birth date 23/07/2000 have to do with 14?
hoi_dap.dap: Adding the digits 2+3+0+7+2+0+0+0 gives 14. In the Chaldean school, the life path of someone born on this date passes through compound number 14 and then reduces to 5.

trich_dan.nghia: Cheiro links 14 to movement and the combination of people and tasks, favourable for money and transactions; he reminds people with this number to be careful about following others' advice.

y_chinh: Compound number 14: movement and combination, reduces to 5 (Mercury)
Favourable for: trade, exchange, travel
Watch for: closing fast, following others without reading yourself
What to do: sleep on an opportunity that comes too fast

muc.tieu_de: What is the meaning of compound number 15 in Chaldean numerology?
muc.doan: Cheiro links compound number 15 to a gift for words, charm and a touch of mystery, often along with a talent for music, painting or performance. He saw people with this number as easily receiving money and help from others. The point to weigh is what that magnetism is used for.

muc.tieu_de: How do you read a name that totals 15, such as “Trang”?
muc.doan: Following the meaning Cheiro gives 15, a name totalling 15 carries a reminder about magnetism, eloquence and artistic talent, with advice to use that magnetism for good ends. “Trang” adds T4, R2, A1, N5 and G3 to make 15. Cheiro also noted that this number often comes with help from others. Reducing to 6 (Venus), the theme of beauty and harmony is stressed further.

muc.tieu_de: Number 15 at work and in love
muc.doan: At work, a 15 usually suits jobs that run on words: sales, training, communications, performance. They can calm a tense meeting. In love, many people notice them, and they need to be honest about what they want. If they use fine words to dodge hard conversations, the other person will gradually lose trust.

muc.tieu_de: How to use the magnetism of 15 well
danh_sach: When persuading someone, mention the weak side of the proposal as well as the attractive side.
Set aside one session a week for real creative work: singing, drawing, writing, photography.
After an important conversation, ask again: “Do you really agree?”.

bang.tieu_de: Names and birth dates that give compound number 15
bang.chu_thich: Each row is added using the Chaldean letter table (letters written without diacritics) or by adding the digits of the birth date; the compound number is the first number in the 10–52 range on the way to reduction, here 15.

hoi_dap.hoi: Is compound number 15 connected with the arts?
hoi_dap.dap: Yes. Cheiro describes 15 as linked to a talent for music and art and a personality with a flair for performance, along with persuasive speech.

hoi_dap.hoi: What is the shadow side of the magnetism of 15?
hoi_dap.dap: It is easy to use charm to get others to go along with you. The habit of also stating the weak points helps that magnetism come with trust.

trich_dan.nghia: Cheiro links 15 to mystery, eloquence, artistic talent and a strong personality; people with this number are often helped by others, and he advises using that magnetism for good ends.

y_chinh: Compound number 15: the pull of words, reduces to 6 (Venus)
Strengths: charming speech, artistic talent
The name “Trang” adds up to 15 in the Chaldean table
What to do: mention the weak points too when persuading

muc.tieu_de: What does compound number 16 mean in the Chaldean school?
muc.doan: Compound number 16 carries the image of a tower struck by lightning: a structure built too high or too fast has to stop and be rebuilt. Cheiro read it as a reminder to plan carefully in advance. The neutral reading is: what no longer fits will need fixing, and fixing early is easier than fixing late.

muc.tieu_de: What about the name “Quang”, which totals 16?
muc.doan: Following the meaning Cheiro gives 16, a name totalling 16 carries a reminder about plans built on shaky ground: think ahead and prepare the foundations carefully. “Quang” adds Q1, U6, A1, N5 and G3 to make 16. The tower struck by lightning is the symbol Cheiro uses for the number, not something that applies to anyone called Quang in particular. Reducing to 7 (Neptune), the number adds a theme of dreams and vision.

muc.tieu_de: Number 16 in projects and relationships
muc.doan: In projects, a 16 is usually strong at the visioning and pitching stage, weaker at checking each step. They do well with a meticulous colleague alongside. In relationships, they can build an ideal image of the other person and then feel let down when reality differs. Talking early about what doesn't feel right helps avoid big breakdowns.

muc.tieu_de: How can a 16 build on firmer ground?
danh_sach: For a big plan, write down three signs that would tell you to stop and fix things.
Each month, review one thing you are doing only because you have already put effort into it.
Ask someone who is good at spotting flaws to read your plan before you announce it.

bang.tieu_de: Names and birth dates that give compound number 16
bang.chu_thich: Each row is added using the Chaldean letter table (letters written without diacritics) or by adding the digits of the birth date; the compound number is the first number in the 10–52 range on the way to reduction, here 16.

hoi_dap.hoi: Is the tower of 16 an omen?
hoi_dap.dap: It is better not to read it as an omen. The tower speaks of a structure that needs to be rebuilt on a truer basis; Cheiro uses it to advise careful planning in advance.

hoi_dap.hoi: What does compound number 16 reduce to, and what does that mean?
hoi_dap.dap: To 7, the number linked to Neptune in Cheiro's system, stressing imagination and inner life.

trich_dan.nghia: Cheiro describes 16 with the image of a tower struck by lightning, speaking of plans that collapse when built on shaky ground; he advises people with this number to think ahead and prepare carefully.

y_chinh: Compound number 16: the tower rebuilt, reduces to 7
Strengths: vision, ideas for big undertakings
Watch for: neglecting the foundations, clinging to outdated plans
What to do: set signals in advance for when to stop and fix

muc.tieu_de: What does compound number 17 mean in Chaldean numerology?
muc.doan: Cheiro called compound number 17 the Star of the Magi, pictured as an eight-pointed star. He linked it to peace, love and the ability to rise above difficulties. According to him, the name of someone with this number is often remembered for a long time, even after they stop doing a particular job.

muc.tieu_de: How do you read a name that totals 17, such as “Thao”?
muc.doan: Following the meaning Cheiro gives 17, a name totalling 17 carries a reminder about peace, love and the strength to overcome difficulties; Cheiro called it the Star of the Magi. “Thao” adds T4, H5, A1 and O7 to make 17. He also believed names with this number are remembered for a long time. Reducing to 8 (Saturn), 17 gains a theme of perseverance and responsibility.

muc.tieu_de: Number 17 in career and family
muc.doan: In their career, a 17 usually suits work that takes a long time to bear fruit: research, teaching, brand building, deep expertise. They are often trusted with work that needs someone with a good reputation. In the family, they are a pillar, but may be so concerned with their long-term image that they miss today's dinner.

muc.tieu_de: Suggestions for using the energy of 17
danh_sach: Choose a long-term goal and break it into small tasks you can do this week.
Each week, give your family a whole session without opening your work laptop.
Write down what you learned after a hard time, for those who come after.

bang.tieu_de: Names and birth dates that give compound number 17
bang.chu_thich: Each row is added using the Chaldean letter table (letters written without diacritics) or by adding the digits of the birth date; the compound number is the first number in the 10–52 range on the way to reduction, here 17.

hoi_dap.hoi: Why is 17 called the Star of the Magi?
hoi_dap.dap: Cheiro uses the image of an eight-pointed star to speak of a peaceful spirit and the strength to rise above trials, with a name that is remembered for a long time.

hoi_dap.hoi: What compound number does the birth date 17/02/2005 give?
hoi_dap.dap: The birth day number is 17. Adding the whole date 1+7+0+2+2+0+0+5 also gives 17, so this person carries compound number 17 in both places.

trich_dan.nghia: Cheiro called 17 the Star of the Magi, a symbol of peace and love; people with this number rise above difficulties, and their names are often remembered for a long time.

y_chinh: Compound number 17: the eight-pointed star, reduces to 8 (Saturn)
Strengths: persevering, keeps their word, lasting reputation
Watch for: caring about long-term image and forgetting people nearby
The date 17/02/2005 carries 17 in both the birth day and the total

muc.tieu_de: What does compound number 18 mean in Chaldean numerology?
muc.doan: Compound number 18 is a tug of war between material desire and inner life. Cheiro used the image of a rayed moon with a dog and a wolf, reading it as a warning about misunderstandings, quarrels at home and deception. The neutral reading: the theme of this number is noticing the conflict inside before it shows on the outside.

muc.tieu_de: How should the name “Tung”, which adds up to 18, be understood?
muc.doan: Following the meaning Cheiro gives 18, a name totalling 18 carries a reminder about the tug between the material and the inner life, and about misunderstandings that can arise at home or among friends. “Tung” adds T4, U6, N5 and G3 to make 18. The reminder belongs to the number; it suggests speaking your mind early and doesn't describe anyone called Tung. Reducing to 9 (Mars), 18 gains a theme of action and staying calm in arguments.

muc.tieu_de: Number 18 at work, with money and in the family
muc.doan: At work, an 18 is usually strong when there is a clear goal and the freedom to decide. With money, they can be pulled towards wanting more, then feel empty once they have it. In the family, small things left unsaid can build up. A regular conversation with the people close to them helps release what isn't sitting right.

muc.tieu_de: How an 18 can keep their balance
danh_sach: When you are annoyed with someone, wait ten minutes before replying to their message.
Next to each money goal, write down one thing you need for your inner life (rest, reading, conversation).
Once a month, talk frankly with someone close about whatever is still unresolved.

bang.tieu_de: Names and birth dates that give compound number 18
bang.chu_thich: Each row is added using the Chaldean letter table (letters written without diacritics) or by adding the digits of the birth date; the compound number is the first number in the 10–52 range on the way to reduction, here 18.

hoi_dap.hoi: Is compound number 18 a quarrelsome number?
hoi_dap.dap: Cheiro describes 18 as linked to disputes and misunderstandings, but it is better read as a reminder: say what bothers you early and there will be less to argue about later.

hoi_dap.hoi: What does 18 reduce to?
hoi_dap.dap: To 9, the number Cheiro links to Mars — the energy of action, determination and going all the way.

trich_dan.nghia: Cheiro describes 18 with the image of a rayed moon where a dog and a wolf fight; he reads it as a tug between the material and the inner life, and reminds people with this number to guard against misunderstandings with family and friends.

y_chinh: Compound number 18: the material–inner tug, reduces to 9
Strengths: determined, quick, bold
Watch for: bottling things up, then exploding at home
What to do: wait ten minutes before replying when annoyed

muc.tieu_de: What does compound number 19 mean in Chaldean numerology?
muc.doan: Cheiro called compound number 19 the Prince of Heaven and linked it to the Sun: joy, respect and success when your efforts are seen. Among the compound numbers, it is one of the brightest he describes. Reducing to 1, it is also the number of the Sun.

muc.tieu_de: What does a name that totals 19, such as “Hung”, say?
muc.doan: Following the meaning Cheiro gives 19, a name totalling 19 carries a reminder about joy, success and recognition; Cheiro called this number the Prince of Heaven. “Hung” adds H5, U6, N5 and G3 to make 19. Both the compound and the root number are linked to the Sun, so confidence and standing out in a crowd are the number's strongest traits. This is a reading of the number; everyone called Hung still writes their own story.

muc.tieu_de: Number 19 at work and in love
muc.doan: At work, a 19 usually suits roles that mean appearing in front of others: team leader, presenter, project launcher. They do well when someone acknowledges them. In love, they are warm and generous, but may find feedback hard to hear. Learning to say “thanks, let me think about it” in the face of criticism is a useful small step.

muc.tieu_de: Making the light of 19 last
danh_sach: After each bit of praise, ask one more person: “What am I still not doing well?”.
Share credit with the people you worked with, naming them when you report.
Set one concrete goal for this quarter and track it every week.

bang.tieu_de: Names and birth dates that give compound number 19
bang.chu_thich: Each row is added using the Chaldean letter table (letters written without diacritics) or by adding the digits of the birth date; the compound number is the first number in the 10–52 range on the way to reduction, here 19.

hoi_dap.hoi: Is compound number 19 the best number in Chaldean numerology?
hoi_dap.dap: Cheiro describes 19 very brightly, linked to joy and respect. Even so, every compound number has its own strengths, and 19 also has something to watch: it can breed complacency.

hoi_dap.hoi: Do two Vietnamese names spelled with the same letters but different tone marks share a compound number?
hoi_dap.dap: Yes. Both spellings of “Hung” have the letters H, U, N, G, so they give the same total of 19 in the Chaldean table, because tone marks and modified vowels are written as plain letters when adding.

trich_dan.nghia: Cheiro called 19 the Prince of Heaven, linked to the Sun; he saw it as the number of happiness, success, respect and recognition.

y_chinh: Compound number 19: Prince of Heaven, reduces to 1 (the Sun)
Strengths: optimistic, confident, well liked
Both spellings of the name “Hung” add up to 19
What to do: ask for feedback after praise

muc.tieu_de: What is compound number 20 in Chaldean numerology?
muc.doan: Compound number 20 is the number of awakening: a call towards a new purpose and new plans. Cheiro describes it with the image of an angel blowing a trumpet to wake people up, and notes that it is not a material number. It suits looking again at what you are living for.

muc.tieu_de: How do you read the name “Lan Anh”, which adds up to 20?
muc.doan: Following the meaning Cheiro gives 20, a name totalling 20 carries a reminder about awakening: a call to get up and work for a new purpose, leaning little towards wealth. “Lan” adds L3, A1 and N5 to make 9, “Anh” adds A1, N5 and H5 to make 11, for a total of 20. The angel with the trumpet is the number's symbol, not a portrait of anyone called Lan Anh. Reducing to 2 (the Moon), 20 adds a theme of feeling and listening.

muc.tieu_de: Number 20 in career choice and relationships
muc.doan: When choosing a career, a 20 usually needs to see that their work helps someone, or they get bored even on good pay. They suit education, care, community work and counselling. In relationships, they need someone willing to talk deeply. The thing to watch: hearing the call to change direction but waiting for the perfect conditions before starting.

muc.tieu_de: What to do while carrying the theme of 20?
danh_sach: Write one sentence: “In a year's time, what do I want to be doing?” and stick it where you can see it.
Pick the smallest step towards it and take it this week.
Tell a trusted person your plan so someone will ask how it's going.

muc.tieu_de: Suggestions for people carrying 21

muc.tieu_de: Is compound number 22 in Chaldean numerology the same as the Pythagorean master number 22?

Its theme is keeping your ideals while checking reality for yourself.

muc.tieu_de: How should the name “Phuc”, which adds up to 22, be understood?

Reducing to 4 (Uranus), the theme of seeing things from a different angle is stressed further.

muc.tieu_de: Number 22 when making decisions and in relationships
muc.doan: When making decisions, a 22 often lets others lead because they dislike friction. In shared ventures such as pooling money for land or opening a shop together, they tend to sign first and read later. In relationships, they are sincere, but may realise late that they are being taken advantage of. The habit of asking “have I seen this with my own eyes?” helps them stay kind without losing out.

muc.tieu_de: How can a 22 be less “blindfolded”?
danh_sach: With important papers, read them all the way through and underline anything you don't understand before signing.
When friends propose a plan, ask at least three specific questions about money and deadlines.

muc.tieu_de: What does compound number 23 mean according to Cheiro?

muc.tieu_de: Number 23 at the office and with older people
muc.doan: At the office, a 23 usually suits projects that need proposals to leadership, applying for funding or raising capital. They know how to present things so that those in power listen. With older relatives or teachers, they are easily well liked. The thing to watch is getting used to waiting for others to open the way, and doing little to prepare their own groundwork.

muc.tieu_de: How to use the support of 23
danh_sach: Before meeting someone who could help you, prepare a one-page summary of what you have done.
Thank people who helped you with a specific message about the result their help made possible.
Learn one skill a month on your own so you don't depend entirely on your supporters.

muc.tieu_de: What is compound number 24 in Chaldean numerology?
muc.doan: Compound number 24 is the number of support through relationships: help from people in influential positions, plenty of affection, usually favourable in love. muc.tieu_de: Number 24 in career and love

muc.tieu_de: Suggestions for a 24 to use relationships in a lasting way
danh_sach: Each week, message an old acquaintance just to ask how they are, without asking for anything.

muc.tieu_de: The meaning of compound number 25 in the Chaldean school
muc.doan: Compound number 25 is strength gained through experience: observing closely, stumbling and drawing lessons. Cheiro read it as a favourable number, but success usually comes after trials rather than early. Reducing to 7, this number gains a reflective quality.

muc.tieu_de: Number 25 at work and in commitment
muc.doan: At work, a 25 is usually strong at analysing root causes, rewriting procedures after an incident, and showing newcomers how to avoid old mistakes. They need time to trust a system. In commitment, they are cautious at first but steady later on. The thing to watch is retelling unhappy old stories again and again, which weighs on the listener.

muc.tieu_de: Turning the experience of 25 into strength
danh_sach: After something doesn't go as hoped, write three lines: what happened, what you learned, what you'll do differently next time.
Share one real lesson with someone new to your field this month.
Set a limit: tell an old story once to someone who needs to hear it, then move on to the next thing.

muc.tieu_de: Number 26 in joint business and family matters

Setting the amount they can bear before agreeing to help saves them awkwardness later.

danh_sach: Any joint contribution above a modest sum gets a few written lines that both sides keep.

muc.tieu_de: What does compound number 27 mean in Chaldean numerology?

muc.tieu_de: Number 27 in leadership and relationships

muc.tieu_de: Suggestions for a 27 to hold the “sceptre” lightly

Hand a whole piece of work to a teammate and don't step in halfway.

muc.tieu_de: What does compound number 28 mean in Chaldean numerology?
muc.doan: Compound number 28 is a number full of contradictions: a promising start, but easy losses through trusting others or through competition. Cheiro advised people with this number to plan for the future. The neutral reading is to build through your own effort and keep something in reserve.

muc.tieu_de: How do you read the name “Phong”, which totals 28?

muc.tieu_de: Number 28 in business, money and trust
muc.doan: In business, a 28 usually meets plenty of competitors and needs a clear edge. With money, they often start well and then fall short by spending on expectations. In relationships, they can stake a whole plan on one person's promise. Spreading risk and keeping an emergency fund helps them feel more secure.

muc.tieu_de: How a 28 can stay on firm ground
danh_sach: Don't put more than a third of your savings into any single plan.
Write down who is responsible for which part before starting shared work.
Each quarter, look at what competitors or others in your field are doing differently.

muc.tieu_de: What does compound number 29 mean according to Cheiro?
muc.doan: Compound number 29 is the number of uncertainty in relationships: hard to know who is sincere, easy to be disappointed by friends or partners. Cheiro wrote about it in quite a heavy tone. The neutral reading is a theme of listening to your intuition, asking directly rather than guessing, and choosing friends slowly.

muc.tieu_de: How should the name “Bich Quyen”, which adds up to 29, be understood?
muc.doan: Following the meaning Cheiro gives 29, a name totalling 29 carries a reminder about tests of trust, uncertainty in love and choosing trustworthy friends. “Bich” adds B2, I1, C3 and H5 to make 11, “Quyen” adds Q1, U6, Y1, E5 and N5 to make 18, for a total of 29. muc.tieu_de: Number 29 in friendship, love and at work
muc.doan: In friendship and love, a 29 usually needs time to trust, and sometimes trusts the wrong person because they want to. They tend to guess what others mean and react to what they imagined. At work, they read the room quickly and suit jobs that need a good understanding of people. Asking one direct question often clears up days of fretting.

muc.tieu_de: Suggestions for people carrying 29
danh_sach: When you are fretting about someone's attitude, ask them one direct question within two days.
Separate “what I saw” from “what I guessed” when you tell a story.
Choose two friends who have proved trustworthy over many years and spend time with them.

muc.tieu_de: What does compound number 30 mean in Chaldean numerology?
muc.doan: Compound number 30 is the number of thoughtful deduction and looking back: using the mind more than strength, putting understanding above wealth. Cheiro noted that people with this number often set material matters aside. He also said it can be fortunate or not, depending on what the person wants.

muc.tieu_de: What about the name “Minh Son”, which totals 30?
muc.doan: Following the meaning Cheiro gives 30, a name totalling 30 carries a reminder about reasoning, looking back and placing intelligence above wealth; whether it is fortunate, he said, depends on the person's own will. “Minh” adds M4, I1, N5 and H5 to make 15, “Son” adds S3, O7 and N5 to make 15, for a total of 30. This is the theme of the number, not a comment on whether anyone called Minh Son is quiet or talkative. Reducing to 3 (Jupiter), 30 adds a theme of sharing what you know.

muc.tieu_de: Number 30 at work and living with others
muc.doan: In their work, a 30 usually suits analysis, writing, editing, research and advising — places where intelligence is paid for more than speed. They don't like competing for position. Living with others, they can make family members feel distant because they rarely express themselves. Checking in once a day helps close that gap.

muc.tieu_de: Making good use of the reflective quality of 30
danh_sach: Each day, ask someone close one question about their day and hear the whole answer.
Write your thoughts up as a short piece and send it to someone for feedback.
Once you have thought enough, set a deadline for the decision instead of thinking more.

hoi_dap.hoi: Is compound number 30 a good number?

muc.tieu_de: What does compound number 31 mean in the Chaldean school?
muc.doan: Compound number 31 is close to 30 but more self-contained: a self-sufficient person living by their own principles, with little need for the crowd. Cheiro saw it as lonely and isolated, not favourable in worldly terms. The neutral reading is a theme of balancing independence and connection.

muc.tieu_de: How do you read the name “Thu Hien”, which totals 31?
muc.doan: Following the meaning Cheiro gives 31, a name totalling 31 carries a reminder about a tendency to close off and live apart from the crowd, which he saw as less favourable in worldly terms. “Thu” adds T4, H5 and U6 to make 15, “Hien” adds H5, I1, E5 and N5 to make 16, for a total of 31. A neutral reading: this number is a reminder to balance time alone with staying connected. Reducing to 4 (Uranus), the theme of going your own way is stressed further.

muc.tieu_de: Number 31 at work and in close relationships
muc.doan: At work, a 31 usually suits self-managed roles: remote work, freelancing, being the specialist in one area. They rarely ask for help, so they sometimes carry more than they can without anyone knowing. In close relationships, they need personal space, and the other person needs to understand that it isn't coldness. Asking for one small favour is a way to practise opening up.

muc.tieu_de: Suggestions to help a 31 be less closed off
danh_sach: This week, ask a colleague or friend for a small favour, then thank them specifically.
Join a small group that meets regularly (a club, a class), even just twice a month.
Tell your loved ones when you need time alone, so they don't misunderstand.

muc.tieu_de: What does compound number 32 mean in Chaldean numerology?
muc.doan: Compound number 32 is the number of communication and of bringing many people together around an idea. Cheiro grouped it with 5, 14 and 23 and said it has an almost magical pull on crowds. The condition he set: people with this number must hold on to their own judgement.

muc.tieu_de: How do you read the name “Quoc Khoa”, which adds up to 32?
muc.doan: Following the meaning Cheiro gives 32, a name totalling 32 carries a reminder about bringing people together, favourable when you keep your own judgement and easily derailed when you give in to other people's stubbornness. “Quoc” adds Q1, U6, O7 and C3 to make 17, “Khoa” adds K2, H5, O7 and A1 to make 15, for a total of 32. Cheiro grouped this number with 5, 14 and 23. Reducing to 5 (Mercury), 32 stresses exchange and quick wits.

muc.tieu_de: Number 32 in teamwork and relationships
muc.doan: In a team, a 32 is usually the one who connects the different sides and mediates when two departments disagree. They suit communications, event organising and team sales. The thing to watch is changing their mind to match whoever spoke last. In relationships, they are fun and lively, but those close to them sometimes find it hard to know what they really think.

muc.tieu_de: Holding on to your judgement as a 32
danh_sach: Before an important meeting, write your view down on paper so you don't get swept along by the majority.
When you want to change your mind halfway, ask yourself: am I changing because of a new argument or because someone is louder?
Choose one small group to go deep with instead of turning up to every gathering.

muc.tieu_de: Is compound number 33 a master number in Chaldean numerology?
muc.doan: No. The Chaldean school has no master numbers, and Cheiro noted that 33 has no power of its own; it carries the same meaning as 24 — support, affection, good relationships. This site reads 33 in the direction of passing on to others the help you once received.

muc.doan: Following the meaning Cheiro gives 33, a name totalling 33 carries a reminder of the same theme as 24: help from people in influential positions and good things that come through affection. “Minh” adds up to 15 and “Tung” to 18; “Thu” is also 15 and “Dung” 18 — two different names with the same total of 33. The example shows that the meaning lies in the number, not in the person: two very different names share the same reminder. Reducing to 6 (Venus), the theme of family becomes clearer.

muc.tieu_de: Number 33 when helping others, at work and in the family
muc.doan: When helping others, a 33 is usually enthusiastic at first and then easily drops it when busy. At work, they suit roles guiding newcomers, caring for customers and social work. In the family, they are the one who remembers birthdays and everyone's favourite dishes. Keeping one small promise to the end usually does more good than promising lots of big things.

muc.tieu_de: How a 33 can keep giving steadily
danh_sach: Choose one specific person to help regularly each month, instead of helping lots of people here and there.
Put promises to help in your calendar like real appointments.
Tell someone younger about a time you were helped and what you learned from it.

muc.tieu_de: What does compound number 34 mean in Chaldean numerology?
muc.doan: According to Cheiro, compound number 34 carries the same meaning as 25: strength formed through experience and observation. What sets this page apart is an outward-facing reading — people with 34 usually do well when they share their lessons so others stumble less.

muc.tieu_de: What about the name “Ngoc Loan”, which totals 34?

That is the meaning of 34; how much experience anyone called Ngoc Loan has is their own business. Reducing to 7 (Neptune), this number adds a theme of reflection.

muc.tieu_de: Number 34 as a mentor and in relationships
muc.doan: At work, a 34 usually suits coaching, training, writing internal guides and career advice. They speak from real experience rather than theory. In relationships, the thing to watch is giving too much advice when the other person only needs to be heard. Asking “do you want my advice or do you just want me to listen?” is a small question that avoids a lot of friction.

muc.tieu_de: Suggestions for people carrying 34
danh_sach: Before giving advice, ask whether the other person wants it.
This month, turn one piece of work experience into a short article or a list of dos and don'ts.
Take a newcomer under your wing for three months and meet them regularly.

muc.tieu_de: Number 35 in business with relatives and money at home
muc.doan: When doing business with relatives, a 35 usually finds it hard to speak plainly for fear of causing offence, and leaves money matters up in the air. At home, they are often the one who keeps the shared fund or lends to siblings. Keeping the accounts separate doesn't cool the affection; on the contrary, it stops both sides suspecting each other later.

muc.tieu_de: Clear boundaries for a 35
danh_sach: When lending to someone you know, write down the amount and the repayment date, and send a message to confirm.
Decide in advance the most you are willing to lend without needing it back.
Hold a family meeting about the shared fund at least once a year, with written records.

muc.tieu_de: Number 36 when working away from home and when leading a team

When leading a team, they are respected for their vision, but can feel lonely in that position without saying so. Having a peer to talk frankly with helps them carry less alone.

muc.tieu_de: Suggestions for people carrying 36

Find someone in the same role elsewhere to talk with every month.
When things feel heavy, tell someone you trust instead of keeping it in.

muc.tieu_de: What does compound number 37 mean in Chaldean numerology?

Unlike 26 or 35, which call for caution in alliances, 37 is read as a number for which working in pairs is easier than working alone.

The theme of relationships belongs to the number; anyone called Hong Uyen still chooses how to make friends. Reducing to 1 (the Sun), 37 keeps the theme of stepping forward to start things.

muc.tieu_de: Number 37 in love and when working in pairs
muc.doan: In love, a 37 is usually described as sincere and good at nurturing. When working in pairs, such as two people opening a shop or writing a proposal together, they are at their best. The thing to watch is relying too heavily on one close person, then feeling lost when that person is busy.

muc.tieu_de: Nurturing relationships as a 37

Put the birthdays and important occasions of the people close to you in your calendar.

muc.tieu_de: How do you read the name “Thanh Tung”, which totals 38?

Reducing to 2 (the Moon), the theme of the atmosphere at home is stressed.

muc.tieu_de: Number 38 in love, in the family and at work
muc.doan: In love and in the family, a 38 usually keeps what they need to themselves until they feel hurt. At work, they sometimes do extra without saying so, then feel sad that nobody noticed. Stating a wish in one specific sentence — “I need you to text me when you'll be home late” — lets the other person know how to respond.

muc.tieu_de: Suggestions for people carrying 38

muc.tieu_de: What does compound number 39 mean in Chaldean numerology?

muc.tieu_de: What about the name “Tuong Linh”, which adds up to 39?

muc.tieu_de: Number 39 in study, writing and decision-making
muc.doan: In study, a 39 usually does well when left to read and find material on their own. They suit writing, editing, data analysis and archiving. In decision-making, the thing to watch is thinking for so long that the moment passes. Setting deadlines and accepting decisions made with less than complete information helps them move on.

muc.tieu_de: Using the research streak of 39

Write for fifteen minutes a day about what you are thinking.
Split a big topic into three small questions and answer them one at a time.

muc.tieu_de: What does compound number 40 mean according to Cheiro?
muc.doan: According to Cheiro, compound number 40 carries the same meaning as 31: the self-sufficient person who lives by their own principles. This page reads 40 through keeping your own rhythm of life amid many demands from work, family and social media.

muc.tieu_de: Number 40 at work and in family life
muc.doan: At work, a 40 usually does well when they can set their own schedule with few interruptions. They don't suit noisy offices with constant meetings. In the family, they keep the household routine going but may see asking for help as weakness. Dividing up the housework clearly stops them taking everything on and wearing themselves out.

muc.tieu_de: Suggestions for a 40 to keep their rhythm
danh_sach: Block out two time slots each week with no meetings and no calls.
This week, ask someone at home to do one thing you always do yourself.
Turn off social media notifications during your main working hours.

muc.tieu_de: How should the name “Thao Nhung”, which totals 41, be understood?

muc.tieu_de: Number 41 in front of a crowd and at home
muc.doan: In front of a crowd, a 41 is usually confident and knows how to hold an audience. They suit teaching, training, presenting and writing for a wide readership. At home, the thing to watch is talking more than doing — promising to fix the shelf and not doing it for three months. Words keep their weight when they come with actions done on time.

muc.tieu_de: Keeping the weight of a 41's words
danh_sach: For every promise this week, note the date you will do it.
Before a talk, prepare one real example from your own life.
After presenting, ask one listener which point they remember.

muc.tieu_de: Number 42 in marriage, family and long-time workplaces

muc.tieu_de: Tending long-standing relationships as a 42
danh_sach: This week, thank someone close for one specific thing they do every day.
Get in touch with an old friend you haven't seen for a long time, even if it is only a call.
Remember an anniversary and do something small for it; it needn't cost much.
